fieldNotes.truckGate: Cross-dock RDC #5851 (657K sq ft) in the CenterPoint Intermodal Center, Joliet/Elwood. A clear guarded gate complex on the south side: guard booth with a canopy, multiple inbound/outbound lanes, and a chevron-striped apron with trucks queued through the checkpoint (z19 imagery).
fieldNotes.guardShack: A canopy-roofed guard booth straddling the gate lanes is plainly visible at the south truck entrance. remoteGs = false accordingly.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Trucks visibly staged/queued on the approach road before the gate; striped apron and road shoulder provide pre-gate waiting room.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide internal aprons inside the gate before the dock faces.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal aprons running both long faces of the N-S building — well over 3 trucks of stacking.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Multi-lane gate (3 inbound observed) with a wide striped apron — room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dense dock-door rhythm with trailers backed in along both the long east and long west faces — well over 100 doors (cross-dock RDC).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock layout — receiving on one long face, shipping on the opposite; two distinct dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer drop-yard rows flanking both long faces.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: CenterPoint Intermodal Center is a large logistics park on rural land between Joliet and Elwood IL, surrounded by farmland and warehouses — judged Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: The CenterPoint Intermodal Center has major intermodal rail yards, but no rail spur runs into this RDC's own property — railServed = false for this facility.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Three inbound lanes estimated from gate imagery; exact count not fully resolved.
